content: Limatan va Sama'ila

A yuwan ta̱ vuma ro aala a̱ yi Elikana, vuma va Zuf za vu ugundo wa Ifiramu u ta̱ nden a̱ lyuci va Rama, e iɗa ya agaɗi ya Ifiramu. A̱yi ulobo wa Yeroham u ɗa ulobo wa Elihu ulobo wa Tohu ulobo wa Zuf vuma va Ifiramu.
U da̱na̱ ta̱ na̱ a̱ma̱ci e re, za ta̱ aala a̱ yi Hanatu za ve ire waru aala a̱ yi a ɗa Penina. Penina ta̱ na̱ muwun, agba Hanatu ri ni i ɗa shi.

Aa'wan suru Elikana tsu lyawa ta̱ lyuci va̱ yi Rama, reve u gawan a̱ 'ya̱wa̱ lyuci va̱ Shilo tsa̱ra̱ u yuwaan A̱sulazuva o oɓolo a̱ a̱soja a zuva a̱ga̱nda̱, waru u yuwaan yi kucci. Olobo e Eli e re Hofini na̱ Finiha ele ɗa a̱ da̱na̱i nan ganu va̱ A̱sulazuva ɗe.
A mantsa ma na suru Elikana cayi kucci va̱ yi, u tsu ca ta̱ ka va̱ yi Penina na̱ muwun mo olobo ma̱ yi suru ne esheli akunda e inama i le.
Amma u tsu ca ta̱ Hanatu akunda a gbain adama a na u ciga yi ta̱ lon, adama a na a̱ A̱sulazuva a̱ ɓa̱ru ta̱ umatsutsun wa̱ yi.
Shewun va̱ yi Penina tsu cukurusa̱ yi ta̱ adama u yuwaan yi ulamu waru u ca yi upan, adama a na A̱sulazuva a̱ ɓa̱ru ta̱ umatsutsun wa̱ yi.
Ucukurusa̱'a̱ u lyuwa ta̱ elime aa'wan suru. Mantsa ma na Hanatu 'ya̱wa̱i o u'wa wa̱ A̱sulazuva suru, shewun va̱ yi tsu cukurusa̱ yi ta̱ adama u ca yi upan, hali u shon reve u 'yuwan a lyuwa ilyalya.
Elikana vali va̱ yi tsu damma yi ta̱, <<Hanatu nye i zuwai vu ri e mesun? Nye i zuwa vu lyuwai ilyalya shi? Waru nye i zuwai vu ri ya̱ a̱tsuma̱la̱ngu? A̱mu n la'aa wu muwun mo olobo kupa shi?>>
Hanatu na̱ Eli
Urana u ro ɗe Shilo ana a lyuwai ilyalya o sowoi, reve Hanatu 'yon u yuwan avasa. Eli ganu gba da̱na̱ ta̱ lo nden o ootogu o una̱ntsutsu wu u'wa wa̱ A̱sulazuva.
Hanatu da̱na̱ ta̱ na̱ a̱tsumola̱ngu lon, a̱vu u yuwan avasa a̱ tyo uba̱ta̱ wa̱ A̱sulazuva na̱ mesun lon.

Reve u yuwan akucunu u damma, <<A̱sulazuva o oɓolo a̱ a̱soja a zuva, na̱ vu ka̱lyuwa̱ a̱tsuma̱lima̱ a aagbashi a̱ wu reve vu cuwan na̱ a̱mu, agba vi icina na aa aagbashi a̱ wu shi, a̱vu vu ca yi ulobo, n ta̱ gba a ca A̱sulazuva a̱yi hali ukwa̱ wa̱ yi. Agba ko utanu wa̱a̱ ju'wa̱n aaci a̱ yi shi.>>
Ana u lyuwai elime na avasa a̱ tyo uba̱ta̱ wa̱ A̱sulazuva, Eli gba e idanasa una̱ wa̱ yi.
Hanatu yuwusan ta̱ avasa a̱tsuma̱ o okolo a̱ yi, una̱ wa̱ yi u ɗa goon u da̱na̱i a̱ ma̱zungwa̱, agba uɗyo wa̱ yi wu uta̱ shi. A̱vu Eli ene ngashi usowu u ɗa u ri.
Reve u damma yi, <<Hali a̱ tyo mantsa ma̱ ne va̱a̱ da̱na̱ usowu? Vu lyawa ne oso a masayan ma̱ inabi.>>

A̱vu Hanatu usu u damma, <<Ne ɗa shi zagbain va̱. A̱mu ka ɗa za na ri na̱ a̱tsumola̱ngu lon. N sowo masayan ma̱ ina̱bi ko ili i ro i na i tsu tsura̱to vuma shi. Amma n ta dansaa A̱sulazuva okolo a̱ va̱.
She vu tara aagbashi a̱ wu tsu ka ve pere wan. N ta avasa mantsa ma nda suru adama a̱ a̱bunda̱ o usa̱n na̱ a̱tsumola̱ngu a na n ri pe.>>
Reve Eli usu yi, <<Ka̱ra̱ na asuvu nden, lyawa A̱sula̱ a aza a Isra'ila a ca wu ili i na vu pati niyi.>>
Reve u damma, <<Lyawa aagbashi a̱ wu a̱ tsura̱ isa'ani e ekere a̱ wu.>> A̱vu ka'a u reme ure wa̱ yi u 'ya̱wa̱ u lyuwa ilyalya. Agba u da̱shi lukuta̱ urewesu wa̱ yi shi.

Ana usana u tawai, reve Elikana na̱ a̱ma̱ci a̱ yi na̱ muwun ma̱ yi a yuwaan A̱sulazuva a̱ga̱nda̱. A̱vu a̱ ka̱mba̱ o u'wa u le a Rama. Ana Elikana voyin na̱ ka va̱ yi Hanatu, reve gba A̱sulazuva a cuwain na̱ a̱yi.
Ana mantsa ma yuwain, reve Hanatu tsura̱ a̱a̱tsuma̱ reve u matsan mawun mo ulobo. Ɗaɗa u ca niyi aala Sama'ila, a dansa, <<M pati ta̱ A̱sulazuva a̱yi.>>
Hanatu ca ta̱ A̱sulazuva Samaꞌila
Ana Elikana nu u'wa wa̱ yi suru a̱a̱ 'ya̱wa̱ tsa̱ra̱ a ca A̱sulazuva kucci va aaꞌwan suru, reve waru u shiton akucunu a̱ yi,
Hanatu 'ya̱wa̱ shi. U damma ta̱ vali va̱ yi, <<Na̱ n kasa mawu'un maani, n ta tara yi a̱ ꞌya̱wa̱ n ca A̱sulazuva a̱yi, waru ɗe ɗa wa̱a̱ da̱na̱ kuci.>>

Reve Elikana usu ka va̱ yi u damma, <<Yuwan ili i na i lobono nuwu. Isawan pa hali she mantsa ma na vu kasa niyi maani. A̱yi de lyawa A̱sulazuva o shiton adanshi a̱ yi goon.>> Ɗaɗa Hanatu da̱nuyi o u'wa u co'o mawu'un hali mantsa ma na u kasa niyi maani.

Ana u kasa niyi maani, reve u tara yi a̱ 'ya̱wa̱ o u'wa wa̱ A̱sulazuva a̱ Shilo, oɓolo na̱ ogono a nan va aꞌwan a taꞌatsu, na̱ makundatsu ma yira kupa ne ejere, na̱ tsa̱n vu ukwan masayan ma̱ ina̱bi, ulobo'o gba a̱yi ubuwu mawun.
Ana a paɗai ogono a na'an, reve Hanatu na̱ Elikana a tara ulobo'o a̱ tyo ye Eli.
Reve Hanatu damma Eli, <<Wuma wa̱ wu ujima zagbain va̱! N kucina ta̱ na̱ a̱vu, a̱mu ɗa ka na da̱na̱i pa nda mishin zuzu na̱ a̱vu a yuwusan avasa a̱ tyo uba̱ta̱ wa̱ A̱sulazuva.
M pati ta̱ mawun ma nda, waru A̱sulazuva a ca mu ta̱ ili i na m pati niyi.
Adama o ndolo gogo n ca ta̱ A̱sulazuva a̱yi, waru u to o'wo e ekere a̱ yi a mantsa ma a wuma wa̱ yi suru.>> Reve a yuwaan A̱sulazuva a̱ga̱nda̱ ɗe.

footnotes.text: Aala Sama'ila na̱ Tsuyahuda a̱yi ɗa <<Aala A̱sula̱,>> una̱ta̱ u ɗa na̱ Tsuyahuda <<Ipati.>>
